intent: Adjusted body width to 0.18m and wheel track to 0.16m to improve stability and reduce line loss events.
rationale: The telemetry indicates that the robot experienced 5 line loss events, which suggests that the current geometry is not adequately supporting line-following performance. To improve stability and reduce line loss, I will adjust the body width to 0.18m, the wheel track to 0.16m, and maintain the sensor size at 0.016m. These changes are expected to enhance the robot's ability to stay on track and improve overall performance in the next iteration.
